messages.message: ### Step 1: Source-Reference Alignment & Semantic Analysis Task: Align source tokens to the provided Reference Translation; pick in-context sense + grammatical role. Output: (a) Interpretation Lock FIRST (one bullet per source line): - Line <ID> <copy exact source line> => Locked Meaning (truth-conditions) - If comparative/degree: define entities A,B, relation (>,<,≈), and degree (e.g., “slightly”). - Note: A>B is equivalent to B<A; do not reverse the ordering. (b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte; 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai, 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte. Reference Translation (provided): So bitter is it that death is little more. But in order to treat of the good that there I found, I will tell of the other things that I have seen there.

**Interpretation Lock – FIRST (one bullet per source line)**
- **Line 7 “Tant' è amara che poco è più morte;”** → **Locked Meaning**: The intensity of *bitter‑ness* (entity **A**) is such that *death* (entity **B**) exceeds it in intensity. The excess is **slight** (degree = *“poco”*). **Truth‑conditions**: if *a* = intensity of “amara” and *d* = intensity of “morte”, then *d > a* and the difference *(d − a)* is small (i.e., “poco più”).
- **Line 8 “ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai,”** → **Locked Meaning**: The speaker, for the purpose of **treating/discussing** the *good* that he **found there**, will address that good. **Truth‑conditions**: the speaker intends (purpose) → *trattar* (to treat) → *del ben* (the good) ← *ch'i' vi trovai* (that I found there).
- **Line 9 “dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte.”** → **Locked Meaning**: The speaker will **tell** about the *other things* that he **has seen there**. **Truth‑conditions**: future verb *dirò* (I will tell) takes complement *de l'altre cose* (of the other things) which are specified by the relative clause *ch'i' v'ho scorte* (that I have seen there).
